comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
Airport run start! Norman Manley to Dunn's River — lesh go!
One time fi Jamaica! Drive safe… or don't.
road.enter: Dis a {road} — nuh speed through here, yuh hear?
community.enter: Yuh pass through {community} — respec' to di community!
landmark.enter: Dat a {landmark} — one of di best inna Jamaica!
pothole.burst: Bwoy, di road dem nuh easy out here!
Lawd — dem need fi fix dis road, sah!
tyre.fixed: Back pon di road! Drive careful dis time, star.
dog.chase: Dawg! Dawg a run yuh dung, brethren!
Weh di dog deh pon yuh?! Step pon it!
Rhatid — di dawg dem bad out here!
Dog! Real dog! Nuh stop fi pet dem!
Lawd, di dog dem want a piece of yuh bumper!
goat.hit: Smaddy goat dat! Yuh owe dem, brethren!
Rhatid! Yuh lick dung di goat!
Cho! Di goat neva see yuh coming either!
Lawd have mercy — man goat inna di road and yuh just run dem dung?!
Unattended goat, unattended driver — nuh true?
